description: Old name for create_test_account; use create_test_account.

email.description: Only with `role`, and only when you ALREADY seeded a sign-in for Tada in the app: its address. Tada adopts it.

environment.description: Only with `role`: which environment, by name. Leave it out unless Tada asks which one.

password.description: The password of the sign-in named by `email`. Tada seals it and never hands it back.

repo.description: The app, as "owner/name". Left out, the workspace's only app.

role.description: A test account in this role, in the app's own word: "admin", "client", "staff". Left out, the app's one test account.

name: setup_test_account
